承𩆩 rendered 'Cheng Hao'; reading of the rare character uncertain.

English 'Tongdele' absorbs 勒 of 勒派 (forced levy); name is 同德 (Tongde).
English 'grand secretary' for 內閣學士.
English 'Chen Shigu' for 陳世倌 (Chen Shiguan).
English 'grand secretary' for 內閣學士.
English 'Ji Zengyun' vs 嵇曾筠 (Ji Zengjun).
English says A Gui was ordered back to Beijing; zh 即日令還京師 ambiguous subject (likely Liu Tongxun returning).
English 'Ministry of Punishments' for 刑部 elsewhere 'justice'.
總河 rendered 'Grand Canal Director' then 'acting director-general'.
軍台效力 rendered 'penal service on the military courier route'.
English 'White Lotus rebels' for 教匪 (sect bandits) is an interpretive gloss.
English renders 本 (Xu Ben) as 'This section'; Xu Ben omitted from English.
